steps: Join Nemon at the location she mentioned — go to Basfelt Waterfall (Kibelisk: Basfelt Waterfall)
Find out what is currently happening at Basfelt Waterfall — talk to Ulgorn (Kibelisk: Basfelt Waterfall)
Ask around to learn what is happening at Basfelt Ruins — talk to Balla, talk to Varatul (Kibelisk: Basfelt Waterfall)
Talk to the Graverobber — talk to Chedan (Kibelisk: Basfelt Waterfall)
Discuss plans with the group — talk to Nemon (Kibelisk: Basfelt Waterfall)

Investigate the Marauder base near the entrance of the ruins — investigate the marauder goods chest, retrieve loot from Marauder Brawler, retrieve antiques from Marauder Watcher, defeat Marauder Brawler, defeat Marauder Watcher (Kibelisk: Graverobber Campsite)
Report the situation to Nemon — talk via Selvis
Gather Intel about the Archon from the Graverobber Campsite — talk to Chedan (Kibelisk: Graverobber Campsite)
Collect accurate intel — talk to Dufaux, talk to Dixie (Kibelisk: Graverobber Campsite)
Discuss future plans — talk to Nemon at the Graverobber Campsite (Kibelisk: Graverobber Campsite)
Turn in — Nemon, Basfelt Ruins
Investigate Reuben's Hideout — go to Reuben's Hideout (Kibelisk: Graverobber Campsite)
Ask the graverobbers — talk to Nemon (Kibelisk: Graverobber Campsite)
Obtain information about the Fortress and the Scripture — talk to Hevid, talk to Dixie, talk to Dufaux (Kibelisk: Graverobber Campsite)
Pass on new information to Nemon — talk to Nemon (Kibelisk: Graverobber Campsite)
Find the loot stolen by marauders — defeat Marauder Warrior ×5, defeat Marauder Ranger ×5, interact with Loot Chest (Kibelisk: Graverobber Campsite)
Turn in — Ulgorn, Graverobber Campsite
Find the secret document Reuben mentioned — go to the Abandoned Ruins (Kibelisk: Shulak Street Stall)
Gain additional information from Dixie — talk to Dixie (Kibelisk: Graverobber Campsite)
Do a favor for Graverobber Dixie — defeat Ferocious Cadaver Cleaner, defeat Ruin Agrint, recover belongings of Dixie's fallen comrade (Kibelisk: Graverobber Campsite)
Talk to Nemon via Selvis — talk via Selvis
Join Nemon at the Destroyed Ruins — talk to Nemon (Kibelisk: Graverobber Campsite)
Insert Zikel's Seal into the Blood Monument — operate the Blood Monument (Kibelisk: Graverobber Campsite)
Turn in — Nemon, Destroyed Ruins
Reduce the number of watchful eyes — destroy Activated Large Balaur Totem, defeat Activated Large Balaur Totem (Kibelisk: Fissure Cave)
Answer Nemon's Selvis Call — talk via Selvis
Capture a Blades Captive — stealthily capture a prisoner (Kibelisk: Fissure Cave)
Eliminate tracking Blades — defeat the ruins Blades (Kibelisk: Fissure Cave)
Accept Nemon's call — talk via Selvis
Turn in — Nemon, Fissure Cave
Defeat the Blades and secure a retreat — defeat Blades Searcher, defeat Blades Messenger (Kibelisk: Fissure Cave)
Purchase Archon's Sword from the Shulak Street Vendor — talk to Purakhi (Kibelisk: Shulak Street Stall)
Fulfill Purakhi's request — retrieve the unexploded bomb, collect the Soulless Archon Armor (Kibelisk: Shulak Street Stall)
Turn in — Nemon, Shulak Street Stall
Investigate the Destruction Archon Underground Fortress — go to the entrance of the Underground Fortress (Kibelisk: Fissure Cave)
Learn how to use the Monolith — talk to Nemon (Kibelisk: Fissure Cave)
Investigate the Destruction Archon Underground Fortress — investigate clues about the core (Kibelisk: Fissure Cave)
Comfort Nemon — talk to Nemon (Kibelisk: Fissure Cave)
Turn in — Nemon, Shulak Street Stall
Ask expert Sculkhi for information — talk to Sculkhi (Kibelisk: Mahindel Cliff)
Join Nemon at the Steel Hammer Merchant HQ — talk to Nemon (Kibelisk: Steel Hammer Merchants HQ)
Gather information on the Blades' base — talk to Seikhi, talk to Brokhi (Kibelisk: Steel Hammer Merchants HQ)
Share the gathered information with Nemon — talk to Nemon (Kibelisk: Steel Hammer Merchants HQ)
Gain the cooperation of the Chief of the Steel Hammer Merchants — talk to Merchant Chief Crobakhi (Kibelisk: Steel Hammer Merchants HQ)

Deliver supplies to the Steel Hammer Workcamp — collect mined Fafnite Gemstone, retrieve the pickaxes from Contaminated Shulak Worker, defeat Contaminated Shulak Worker (Kibelisk: Gribade Highland Crossroad)
Turn in — Mannikiki, Steel Hammer Workcamp
Clear the path to the Shuttered Workstation — defeat Contaminated Shulak Miner (Kibelisk: Steel Hammer Workcamp)
Check the Shuttered Workstation situation — enter the Shuttered Workstation (Kibelisk: Abandoned Campsite)
Listen to a detailed explanation from Mannikiki — talk to Mannikiki (Kibelisk: Steel Hammer Workcamp)

Find survivors in the east of the deposit — search for survivors around quarry entrance, search for survivors inside central quarry, search for survivors around quarry wall (Kibelisk: Steel Hammer Workcamp)
Accept Nemon's Call — talk via Selvis
Find items for the surviving workers — find the worker's lost bag, defeat the dangerous Luminous Cadaver Insectoid (Kibelisk: Steel Hammer Workcamp)
Turn in — Nemon, Steel Hammer Workcamp
